quotes.title: WASP-42
quotes.card: WASP-42 is a K-type main-sequence star about 580 light-years away in the constellation Centaurus.
quotes.introduction: Its surface temperature is 5315±79 K. WASP-42 is similar to the Sun in concentration of heavy elements, with metallicity ([Fe/H]) of 0.05±0.13, and is much older than the Sun at 11.3+1.5−4.8 billion years.
